create_LazyVariableTracker: create a LazyVariableTracker to defer VariableTracker construction until accessed
realize_LazyVariableTracker: realize a LazyVariableTracker to force construction of the underlying VariableTracker
check_is_realized: check if a LazyVariableTracker has been realized without triggering realization
unwrap_LazyVariableTracker: unwrap a LazyVariableTracker to get the real VariableTracker if already realized
clone_LazyVariableTracker: clone a LazyVariableTracker, realizing it if the source differs
